snippet.title: Alpha Nomos - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529960/Alpha_Nomos/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
